lead: A `.nvst` case cannot carry a body that is not UTF-8.
body: `--POST_RAW--` crosses to `nvs run --request` as a `String` (`crates/nvs-test/src/request.rs:100`), so nothing in that path spells one. Build the octets in the program instead — `Core\Encoding::fromHex` into `Core\Test::request`'s `body` key.
